title: Oven Roasted Venezuelan Beef Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting Venezuelan dish featuring tender beef, sweet candied peel, and a rich Mediterranean-inspired sauce, perfect for a sick day or a cozy evening, served in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the tomato paste, beef broth, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, while preparing the candied peel and crushed crackers.
In a small bowl, mix together the candied peel and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the beef mixture into individual mini cocottes, followed by a spoonful of the candied peel mixture.
Top each cocotte with a sprinkle of crushed crackers.
Place the cocottes on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, or until the crackers are golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
